grammarFocus: 条件句；数量词；段落间的指代与衔接。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.

title: The Missing Survey: A Team Learns to Check Its Data
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。文章和问题都是英语，解释是中文。所有内容为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。先读文章，再做题。做题时注意条件句、数量词和段落间的指代与衔接。
passage:
A. The Brightline Marketing Team was excited. They had just finished a small survey about a new coffee shop, and the results looked great. Forty people answered the survey. Thirty-two said they would buy coffee there every week. The team leader, Maya, said, "If 80 percent of people say yes, then we should open the shop next month." Everyone agreed. They started to plan the opening.

B. But one team member, Leo, was not sure. He looked at the survey again. "Wait," he said. "We only asked people in our office building. And most of them are coffee drinkers already. If we ask people in other places, the answer might be different." Maya stopped. She looked at the numbers. "You are right," she said. "We have data, but it is not complete data."

C. The team decided to check their conclusion. They made a new plan. They would ask 100 people in three different places: the office building, a park, and a shopping center. They would also ask two questions: "Do you drink coffee?" and "Would you buy coffee here every week?" This time, they wanted a bigger and more varied group. They wanted to collect information from different types of people, not just office workers. They also wanted to represent the whole community better, so they chose places where many different people go.

D. The new results were very different. Of the 100 people, only 45 drank coffee. And of those 45, only 20 said they would buy coffee every week. That was just 20 percent of the whole group. Maya looked at the new numbers and said, "If we use only the first survey, we will make a mistake. The first group was too small and too special."

E. Leo added, "We also need to think about how many people walk by the shop each day. If only a few people pass by, even coffee drinkers will not stop." The team wrote a short report. They said: "Our first conclusion was too strong. We need more data from different places before we decide." They did not open the shop next month. Instead, they waited and collected more information. They also talked to a few coffee shop owners to learn about foot traffic. This helped them make a better decision about the shop.

F. In the end, the team learned an important lesson. A small number can tell you something, but it cannot tell you everything. When you make a conclusion, ask: Who did we ask? Where did we ask them? How many people answered? If the group is small or special, the result may not be true for everyone. Good decisions need good data, and good data need good questions. The team did not give up on the coffee shop idea. They just knew they needed to collect more information and represent all possible customers before making a final decision.

questions.prompt: How many people answered the first survey?
questions.explanation: 文章第一段明确说“Forty people answered the survey.”，所以是四十人。

questions.prompt: In the first survey, how many people said they would buy coffee every week?
questions.explanation: 第一段说“Thirty-two said they would buy coffee there every week.”，因此是32人。
questions.evidence: Thirty-two said they would buy coffee there every week.

questions.prompt: Why did Leo think the first survey was not enough?
options: Because they only asked people in their office building.
Because the survey was too long.
Because Maya did not like the results.
answers: Because they only asked people in their office building.
questions.explanation: 第二段Leo说“We only asked people in our office building.”，这是他质疑数据不完整的原因。
questions.evidence: We only asked people in our office building.

questions.prompt: Where did the team ask people in the new plan?
options: The office building, a park, and a shopping center
answers: The office building, a park, and a shopping center
questions.explanation: 第三段说他们会在三个不同地方问100人：“the office building, a park, and a shopping center”。
questions.evidence: They would ask 100 people in three different places: the office building, a park, and a shopping center.

questions.prompt: In the new survey, how many people drank coffee?
questions.explanation: 第四段说“Of the 100 people, only 45 drank coffee.”，所以是45人。
questions.evidence: Of the 100 people, only 45 drank coffee.

questions.prompt: What percentage of the whole new group said they would buy coffee every week?
questions.explanation: 第四段说“That was just 20 percent of the whole group.”，因此是20%。
questions.evidence: That was just 20 percent of the whole group.

questions.prompt: According to the passage, what did the team decide to do after the new results?
options: They waited and collected more information.
They opened the shop next month.
They asked only ten more people.
answers: They waited and collected more information.
questions.explanation: 第五段说“They did not open the shop next month. Instead, they waited and collected more information.”，所以他们等待并收集更多信息。
questions.evidence: They did not open the shop next month. Instead, they waited and collected more information.

questions.prompt: The passage says: 'If the group is small or special, the result may not be true for everyone.' What does this mean?
options: A small or special group may not represent all people.
answers: A small or special group may not represent all people.
questions.explanation: 这句话的意思是：如果群体小或特殊，结果可能不适用于所有人，即不一定能代表所有人。选项A最准确。
questions.evidence: If the group is small or special, the result may not be true for everyone.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the passage: The team leader's name is ______.
questions.explanation: 第一段说“The team leader, Maya, said...”，所以团队领导的名字是Maya。
questions.evidence: The team leader, Maya, said, "If 80 percent of people say yes, then we should open the shop next month."

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the passage: Leo said, 'We only asked people in our ______ building.'
questions.explanation: 第二段Leo说“We only asked people in our office building.”，所以填office。
questions.evidence: We only asked people in our office building.

grammar.title: 条件句、数量词与段落衔接
grammar.explanation: 本课重点：1) 条件句：If + 一般现在时，主句用 will/can/may + 动词原形，表示“如果……就……”。例如：If we ask more people, we will get a better answer. 2) 数量词：a few（几个，少量），many（许多，可数），much（许多，不可数），a small number of（少量的），percent（百分比）。3) 段落间的指代与衔接：用 this/these/that/those 指代前文内容，用 however/therefore/instead 等连接词使段落连贯。注意：条件句主句不能用 will 再加动词原形以外的形式；数量词要与名词可数性搭配。
grammar.example: If we use only the first survey, we will make a mistake.

questions.prompt: If we ______ more people, we will get a better answer.
questions.explanation: 条件句：If 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。所以填 ask。
questions.evidence: If we use only the first survey, we will make a mistake.

questions.prompt: If the group is small, the result ______ not be true for everyone.
questions.explanation: 条件句主句可以用 may + 动词原形，表示“可能”。这里用 may 最合适。
questions.evidence: If the group is small or special, the result may not be true for everyone.

questions.prompt: There are only ______ people in the park today.
questions.explanation: people 是可数名词复数，用 a few 表示“几个”。much 和 a little 修饰不可数名词。
questions.evidence: If only a few people pass by, even coffee drinkers will not stop.

questions.prompt: We do not have ______ information about the shopping center.
questions.explanation: information 是不可数名词，用 much 表示“许多”。many 和 a few 修饰可数名词。
questions.evidence: Instead, they waited and collected more information.

questions.prompt: Only 20 ______ of the people said yes.
questions.explanation: percent 表示百分比，通常不加 s。这里说“20 percent of the people”。
questions.evidence: That was just 20 percent of the whole group.

questions.prompt: The first survey was small. ______, the team decided to ask more people.
questions.explanation: 前句是原因，后句是结果，用 Therefore（因此）连接。
questions.evidence: The team decided to check their conclusion.

questions.prompt: Leo looked at the survey again. ______ he found a problem.
questions.explanation: 表示时间顺序“然后”，用 Then。Because 和 If 不表示顺序。
questions.evidence: He looked at the survey again.

questions.prompt: If we ______ only the first survey, we will make a mistake.
questions.explanation: 条件句 If 从句用一般现在时，所以用 use。
questions.evidence: If we use only the first survey, we will make a mistake.

speaking.part2: Describe a time when you or someone you know made a decision with incomplete information. You should say: what the decision was; what information was missing; what happened as a result; and what you learned from it.

transfer.writing: Write a short report (about 120–150 words) for a school club. The club wants to start a weekend reading group. You asked 20 students, and 15 said yes. But you only asked students in one class. Write a report that: states the first result; explains why the data may be incomplete; suggests how to collect better data; and gives a final recommendation. Use at least two conditional sentences and two quantity words (e.g., a few, many, much, percent).
